DiPageContent.title: Hero subtitle
DiPageContent.text: Join Us at Dance Institute Today

DiPageContent.title: About paragraph 1
DiPageContent.text: At Dance Institute, we are passionate about teaching dance to students aged 2 to adult. Our extensive curriculum includes Ballet, Tap, Lyrical, Contemporary, Pointe, Hip-Hop, Poms, Acro, Tumbling, and Jazz. We create a nurturing environment where students not only learn to dance but also develop confidence, dedication and self awareness.

DiPageContent.title: About paragraph 2
DiPageContent.text: Welcome to Dance Institute in Denver, CO. We are a staff of dedicated, passionate dance educators eager to work with dancers of all ages and help them grow into the amazing dancers they aspire to be. Each one of our teachers have put in countless hours learning and growing in the world of dance from very young ages. Our teachers have performed in the industry and have taught many students. There is no doubt your dancers will love every moment of gaining knowledge from these talented people.

DiPageContent.title: About paragraph 3
DiPageContent.text: Our Denver dance school offers students a nurturing environment geared towards cultivating the best of each dancer. We want every student to feel supported in their effort to develop into the best dancer they can possibly become, whether they want to grow up and move into the professional field of dance or learn to dance because it is just plain fun. Every dancer is different. We are here to help students discover their strengths and work on their weaknesses to make them a more well-rounded dancer.

DiPageContent.title: About paragraph 4
DiPageContent.text: We strive for our dance studio to make every student feel at home. We treat all our students like family. Once you get to know the parents and staff, the studio will begin to feel like your home away from home. It is our desire to make you feel comfortable while you are here, while we focus on making your dancers feel encouraged, inspired, and supported.

DiPageContent.title: About paragraph 5
DiPageContent.text: By providing technical training in a friendly and encouraging atmosphere. Our mission is for Dance Institute students to have a well-rounded dance education. We are dedicated to our students' self-assurance, poise, and confidence.

DiPageContent.body: This week prepares dancers for their Nutcracker audition. Any dancer wanting to put extra focus into their ballet dancing before they audition is encouraged to come dance with us this week.

DiPageContent.title: Rehearsal details and registration link
DiPageContent.body: Rehearsals last 30–90 minutes, depending on the role. We make every effort to accommodate performers’ schedules. Performers may miss no more than two rehearsals. The rehearsal fee is $130 and can be paid under Events on the Register Now! page.

DiPageContent.title: Competition introduction
DiPageContent.body: We typically attend three competitions in April and May.

DiPageContent.title: Recital information
DiPageContent.body: We present three shows in early June to showcase what our dancers have been learning in class. Younger classes perform in one show, while some classes perform in all three.

DiPageContent.title: Summer Intensive dates and days
DiPageContent.text: Classes meet Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays from June 17th–July 31st.

DiPageContent.title: Summer holiday exception
DiPageContent.text: No class the week of July 4th.

DiPageContent.title: Summer combined course description
DiPageContent.body: Your dancer will have 54 hours of training this summer with our intensive. Our Intensive is perfect for dancers 11 and older that are looking to not only maintain their dance over the summer but to grow and be challenged.

DiPageContent.title: Summer attendance and flexibility
DiPageContent.body: We understand there are vacations planned and students will miss some days here and there. This intensive is designed to accommodate busy schedules with an open curriculum and an extremely discounted price. As well as, no Monday or Friday classes.

DiPageContent.title: Summer camp schedule notice
DiPageContent.body: Schedule is subject to change or cancellation. Sign-up early to get the week you want.

DiPageContent.title: Summer camp full day and pickup information
DiPageContent.body: Full-day camp is available by combining morning and afternoon camps. Early drop-off and Late pick-up are available for an additional charge of $10.00 per 30 minutes. Our Lunch Hour is Noon-1:00 PM.

DiPageContent.title: Summer camp lunch information
DiPageContent.body: Campers in both the All-day and Half-day camps are welcome to join us for lunch.

DiPageContent.title: Contact introduction
DiPageContent.text: We are excited to hear from you! If you have any questions about our classes, schedule, or anything else, please reach out using the form below. Our team will respond promptly to ensure you have all the information you need.

DiPageContent.title: Registration instructions
DiPageContent.body: Please click “Register Now!” then click “Learn More.” Once you have purchased your membership, you will be guided through the registration process. Ignore our waitlists. We have put those in place to ensure all the appropriate discounts are applied. If you have any questions or need any assistance please call 303-525-0011.

DiPageContent.title: Recital gala
DiPageContent.body: Our gala is an opportunity to support the studio, take part in bidding, and enjoy performances of our competition dances.

DiPageContent.title: Introduction 1
DiPageContent.body: At Dance Institute, we are dedicated to ensuring our dance studio is welcoming and accessible to everyone, including individuals with disabilities. We strive to provide an inclusive environment that empowers all students to express themselves through dance.

DiPageContent.title: Opening paragraph 1
DiPageContent.body: This statement was last updated on [enter relevant date]. We at Dance Institute are committed to making our studio and website accessible to all individuals, ensuring everyone can engage with our dance programs.

DiFeatures.title: Parental Viewing
DiFeatures.body: Dance Institute welcomes parents to view classes. We want you to see what your child is learning and growing from the instruction provided from our teachers. We also offer comfortable chairs in a designated viewing area.

DiFeatures.title: Affordable Classes
DiFeatures.body: We offer combination classes so that students receive a well-rounded dance education without the expense of attending multiple classes. You can learn hip hop dance, ballet, tap dance and more at our Denver studio.

DiFeatures.title: Non-competitive Atmosphere
DiFeatures.body: No student or group of students receives more performing focus than others. All our dance students are welcomed into our dance community. Our dance studio offers a supportive atmosphere and provide an educational dance platform to allow your dancer to grow to their fullest potential.

DiFeatures.title: Community Focused
DiFeatures.body: We perform at many community events throughout Denver, and at retirement homes as well. We donate show proceeds to local schools as well as raise funds for local charities.

DiFeatures.title: Parental Involvement
DiFeatures.body: The Dance Institute Parent Organization (DIPO) is designated to create community within our Denver dance school. Parent involvement is key to success in any education and we encourage all our parents to become involved in our parent community.

DiFeatures.title: Structured Curriculum
DiFeatures.body: The Dance Institute school year runs September through June with a recital in June. Students will ""graduate"" in June into the classes starting the following September.

DiTestimonials.title: Lauren Still
DiTestimonials.quote: "My daughter has grown up with a love of dance from a young age thanks to 5+ years with Dance Institute LLC and Ms. Michele. Dance Institute LLC has offered the perfect balance for our young dancer — great instruction and progressive growth with a relaxed, family-friendly, non-competitive atmosphere. I highly recommend Ms. Michele and Dance Institute"

DiTestimonials.title: Sarah B.
DiTestimonials.quote: "Dance with Miss Michele is the highlight of my (4 year old) daughter's week. This is her second year dancing and, not only does she continue to love it, but aslso she is learning all the basics at a young age.  Michele does a great job meeting her young students where they are and steadily teaching them skills poise , and positions while they smile and dance the hour away."

DiTestimonials.title: Olivia Brown
DiTestimonials.quote: "Every class at Dance Institute is an opportunity to express myself and improve my skills. I love being part of this amazing dance family!"

DiTestimonials.title: Lera Andronova
DiTestimonials.quote: “Dance Institute has helped me grow in so many ways, both as a dancer and as a person, and taught me lessons I’ll carry with me for the rest of my life. I have so much love for the teachers and dancers who make it such a special place. Everyone is so supportive, and DI really feels like my second family!”

DiTeachers.name: Miss Michele
DiTeachers.bio:
“A dream comes true” is how Miss Michele views Dance Institute LLC. With a passion for dance since the age of 3 and a passion for teaching since 9, the best way to describe Dance Institute is “living a dream.”

“First and foremost I am a teacher,” Miss Michele says. “To see a student learn and then master their technique is an absolute joy for me. Nothing in the world makes me happier than to see my students blossom into dancers.” Miss Michele adapts her style for a wide variety of ages while maintaining a fun and playful atmosphere. Miss Michele has been dancing for 40+ years and is trained in ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop, modern, tumbling and ballroom. She accumulated many performances and choreography credits while attending the University of Minnesota. She was also the TA for tap and ballroom courses at the University and started assisting in ballet, jazz, tap and tumbling class at the age of 14.

“Assisting was the best way to develop my technique. After hundreds of plies and shuffles 4 hours a day, 4 days per week, mastery appeared.” says Miss Michele. After college, she taught at a large studio in Minnesota where she developed her choreography muscle that originally appeared in college.

Dance Institute LLC is family-owned and operated and, since we opened our doors in 2005, we’ve treated every customer like they were a part of our family.

DiPolicies.title: Rules and Safety
DiPolicies.body:
Safety is of the utmost importance. The best way for everyone to be safe is to follow directions.

  • Students that pose a risk to others with their behavior will be asked to sit out.
  • No hanging from the ballet barres.
  • No gum or jewelry in class.
  • Students may bring a closed water bottle into class.

DiPolicies.title: Attire
DiPolicies.body: Proper attire is very important in dance. It allows for freedom of movement and is also needed for the instructor to view a student’s body positions. Female dancers up to age 9 will wear black short sleeve leotards and pink tights. Tights and leotards of any color are the base attire for all classes. Skirts may be worn during Ballet and dance pants may be worn during Jazz, Tap and Hip-Hop. Male dancers of all ages may wear dance pants and T-shirts. Please, nothing loose or baggy. All dancers will need the proper shoes. Dancewear can be purchased through the studio.

DiPolicies.title: Hair
DiPolicies.body: Hair must be off the face. A bun is best for long hair. Pigtails are best for students in tumbling.

DiPolicies.title: Class viewing
DiPolicies.body: While viewing class, we ask that you refrain from talking.

DiCompetitionInfo.title: The Team
DiCompetitionInfo.body: A competition team brings dancers together to strengthen their technique, develop stage presence and support one another. Teamwork, steady progress and a love of performing are at the heart of the experience.

DiCompetitionInfo.title: Rehearsals
DiCompetitionInfo.body: Large-group dances rehearse during class. Solos, duos, trios, and small groups rehearse on weekends.

DiCompetitionInfo.title: Events
DiCompetitionInfo.body: Competition weekends offer a chance to perform, receive feedback and celebrate progress together. Dates, venues, arrival times and performance schedules help families prepare for each event.

DiCompetitionInfo.title: Getting Ready
DiCompetitionInfo.body: Pack your costume, dance shoes, water and any hair or makeup supplies you need. Review the event schedule in advance, arrive ready to warm up and support your teammates throughout the day.

DiCompetitionInfo.title: Costs
DiCompetitionInfo.body: Competition participation may involve entry fees, costumes and travel. Review the season’s cost breakdown and payment schedule before committing, and ask about any additional expenses.

DiCompetitionInfo.title: Questions
DiCompetitionInfo.body: Interested in the competition experience? Contact the studio to discuss your dancer’s goals and learn about team placement, preparation and the next steps.

DiCompetitionInfo.title: Choreography
DiCompetitionInfo.body: Our teachers choreograph competition dances, with self-choreography available for older dancers.

DiLegalSections.title: A legal disclaimer
DiLegalSections.body: The explanations and information provided on this page are only general and high-level explanations and information on how to write your own document of a Privacy Policy. You should not rely on this article as legal advice or as recommendations regarding what you should actually do, because we cannot know in advance what are the specific privacy policies you wish to establish between your business and your customers and visitors. We recommend that you seek legal advice to help you understand and to assist you in the creation of your own Privacy Policy.

DiLegalSections.title: Privacy Policy - the basics
DiLegalSections.body:
Having said that, a privacy policy is a statement that discloses some or all of the ways a website collects, uses, discloses, processes, and manages the data of its visitors and customers. It usually also includes a statement regarding the website’s commitment to protecting its visitors’ or customers’ privacy, and an explanation about the different mechanisms the website is implementing in order to protect privacy. 

Different jurisdictions have different legal obligations of what must be included in a Privacy Policy. You are responsible to make sure you are following the relevant legislation to your activities and location.

DiLegalSections.title: What to include in the Privacy Policy
DiLegalSections.body:
Generally speaking, a Privacy Policy often addresses these types of issues: the types of information the website is collecting and the manner in which it collects the data; an explanation about why is the website collecting these types of information; what are the website’s practices on sharing the information with third parties; ways in which your visitors and customers can exercise their rights according to the relevant privacy legislation; the specific practices regarding minors’ data collection; and much, much more. 

To learn more about this, check out our article “Creating a Privacy Policy”.

DiLegalSections.title: What web accessibility is
DiLegalSections.body: An accessible platform allows everyone, regardless of ability, to participate in our dance classes and activities with ease and enjoyment. Our goal is to accommodate all students, ensuring they have equal access to our resources.

DiLegalSections.title: Accessibility adjustments on this site
DiLegalSections.body:
We have adapted our website in accordance with WCAG 2.1 guidelines and have made it accessible to the level of AA. Our site is compatible with assistive technologies, such as screen readers, to enhance the user experience for all visitors.

  • Utilized accessibility tools to identify and rectify issues
  • Set the language for our site
  • Organized content for easy navigation
  • Established clear headings on all pages
  • Provided alternative text for images
  • Ensured color contrast meets accessibility standards
  • Minimized motion effects on the site
  • Made sure all multimedia content is accessible

DiLegalSections.title: We acknowledge partial compliance with the standard due to certain third-party content.
DiLegalSections.body: The accessibility of specific pages relies on content from [enter relevant third-party name]. The following pages may not fully comply: [list URLs of affected pages]. We declare partial compliance for these pages.

DiLegalSections.title: Accessibility arrangements in the organization
DiLegalSections.body: Our studio locations are equipped with ramps and designated parking for individuals with disabilities. We ensure that all spaces, including classrooms and restrooms, are accessible and welcoming. Additional support services are available upon request.
